name: Jiangsu HHCK Advanced Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu HHCK Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of semiconductor packaging materials, such as epoxy molding compounds and electronic adhesives in China. The company offers semiconductor devices, integrated circuits, special devices, and LEDs, as well as electronic packaging materials, such as brackets. Its products are used in semiconductor packaging, structural component packaging, and board-level assembly; chip bonding, chip-level molding. Jiangsu HHCK Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. was founded in 2010 and is based in Lianyungang, China.
